verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents multi-currency card issuing with reduced international transaction/FX fees and marketing claims of 'No FX Fees' corporate cards, plus interbank-rate conversions, which supports spending abroad without hidden FX costs. However, evidence is vendor-provided marketing/docs only, with no independent verification, and no explicit mention of cash withdrawal (ATM) fees abroad specifically. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of no-FX-fee claim, explicit ATM cash withdrawal fee terms, third-party corroboration.
